title: Mounted Hop moves rider and Pokémon as one motion

verification.actor: MOUNTED species56 Mankey prepared in party slot0, bound through its live handle and attached presentation; the same party subject detaches and remounts.
verification.trigger: Hold alternating RIGHT and LEFT for1000 twenty-frame actions; release movement, press and release SELECT to detach; take an unmounted RIGHT step; press and release SELECT to remount; take a mounted RIGHT recovery Hop and settle.
verification.observable: The unchanged legacy.mankey-control-stress measurements require completed-natural-hop-count >=200, mankey-stress-active-frame-count >=5001, mankey-stress-identity=[1,MOUNTED,56,1], actor-owned-hop-motion-count >=1, valid-mounted-hop-motion-count covering at least200 motions, and dismount-and-remount-milestones=[1,1,1,1,IDLE,0].

setupMutations.change: Private test.sav; teleport to map33 tile584/403; prepare party slot0 as species56, level10, HP1 and status0; spawn that own party subject mounted through the checked follower lifecycle, settle16 frames and bind its current identity. No profile, timer, counter or callback changes. Observation uses only normal step input.

limits: Prepared party and mount setup do not prove natural acquisition or the selection UI.
All original named stress and detach/remount measurements remain required. A recipe or host pass alone grants no gameplay proof.
The20000-frame route is a bounded attempt; insufficient Hops, active frames, callback coverage or control milestones fail rather than lowering the legacy thresholds.

events.value: Release movement, detach with SELECT and take an unmounted RIGHT step
Remount with SELECT, take one mounted RIGHT recovery Hop and settle

stop.condition: Sustained Hop meets every original stress threshold, then detach, unmounted movement, remount and mounted recovery finish

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
Every active actor has an attached presentation
